title: Non Shaded Path Blocks
body:
A simple resource pack that removes shading from path blocks, making them stand out much more.

---
### • How?
> This pack simply adds ```"ambientocclusion": false``` to the path block model, which tells the game to skip shading it.

### • Sodium?
> Yes, but because of a bug in sodium, non-fluid non-full blocks (e.g. path blocks) arent shaded by default, unless you are using the [Sodium Shadowy Path Blocks](https://modrinth.com/project/EIa1eiMm) mod, so you wont need this resource pack in the first place.

### • Modpacks?
> You may use this resource pack in your modpacks as long as you provide a visible link to this page and dont claim it as your own.
